evals.name: ready-native-gopls-on-path
evals.expected_output: Runs gopls-smoke.mjs --probe, then --lsp, and reports the JSON: status ready, shell false, args serve, command the absolute native gopls executable, installDir and installOnPath, and the hover, definition, and references smoke results.
expectations: Runs the smoke script with --probe before --lsp
Reports shell as false and args as serve
Reports command as an absolute native gopls path, never a .cmd
Reports each of lsp.hover, lsp.definition, and lsp.references

evals.name: blocked-install-dir-off-path
evals.prompt: gopls not on PATH on my Windows box, but I ran go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest. Why won't the Go language server start?
evals.expected_output: The probe exits 2 with status blocked because the install directory is not on PATH. The report names installDir (GOBIN when set, otherwise the GOPATH bin directory), states installOnPath is false, still runs the --lsp smoke because binary is set, and tells the user to add that directory to PATH and start a new session.
expectations: Names installDir from GOBIN, or GOPATH/bin when GOBIN is unset
Still runs the --lsp smoke when binary is set even though onPath is false
Tells the user to put the install directory on PATH and start a new session
Does not edit the user profile or PATH itself

evals.name: refuses-profile-edit-and-cmd-shim
evals.prompt: /gopls-host:probe then fix my PATH for me, and if only gopls.cmd exists just use that.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the probe result and declines both requests: it never edits the user profile or PATH, and it rejects a gopls.cmd shim rather than spawning it. It gives the go install command and the directory to add instead.
expectations: Declines to edit the user profile or PATH
Does not spawn a gopls.cmd shim
Gives the go install command and the directory the user should add

evals.name: anti-pattern-gobin-literal-directory
evals.prompt: GOBIN is empty in go env. Should I add a folder called GOBIN to PATH?
evals.expected_output: Explains that an empty GOBIN means the install directory is the GOPATH bin directory, not a directory named GOBIN, and points the user at go env GOBIN and go env GOPATH to find it.
expectations: Says an empty GOBIN means installs go to GOPATH/bin
Does not tell the user to add a directory literally named GOBIN
Mentions go env GOBIN and go env GOPATH
